clauses.reason: whole: EO 12176 (signed 1979-12-07, 44 FR 70705) revises Sections 1-401 and 1-402 of EO 12103 (President's Commission on the Coal Industry): the final report is due by March 15, 1980 (held text: "The final report required by section 1-202 of this O rder shall be" followed on the next line by the date; a report deadline, not an end) and the held FR text of Sec. 1-402 reads "shall term inate on M arch 1 5 ,1980." (the Commission shall terminate on March 15, 1980). First end: the stated sunset of Sec. 1-402 as revised, March 15, 1980, recorded inclusive (the order runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when March 15, 1980 begins, is the alternative (owner ruling 2026-10-21 until-dates). The actor is EO 12176 itself (own terms); the commission's termination ends the clause because both revised sections concern only the Commission's report and life. Later event: EO 12258 (signed 1980-12-31, 46 FR 1251), Sec. 1-103(g), revokes "Executive Order No. 12103, as amended, establishing the President’s" (continuing: Commission on the Coal Industry) in a list of orders that "that established committees which" have terminated or whose work is completed, and Sec. 1-105 provides "1-105. This Order shall be effective December 31,1980." That revocation postdates the sunset, does not name EO 12176 and is therefore a later event, not the first end. The OFR catalog note on the target reads "Revoked by: EO 12258, December 31, 1980". No extension of the March 15, 1980 date is held.
